issues.title: Missing toggle switch affordances
issues.description: The toggle items under 'Deployment options' fail to render toggle switch controls (track and thumb), presenting only as icon-label rows with inconsistent container styling.
issues.evidence: The four items in 'Deployment options' ('Verbose build logs', 'Auto-rollback on failure', 'Notify #ops-on-call in Slack', 'Require compliance approval before promote') contain no switch/knob indicators to convey toggle state or affordance.
issues.suggestion: Include the visual toggle switch track and thumb element aligned to the right edge of each Toggle component row.
issues.triageNote: Partly an auditor misread (Toggle is a pressable chip, not a switch — ui:switch exists for settings rows; the eval page's Toggle-as-settings-rows usage is composition we cannot edit), but the underlying defect is real: the pressed state data-[state=on]:bg-accent is ~1.1:1 vs white panels in light theme and exactly equal to --color-panel in dark theme, so on/off state was effectively invisible — fixed by inverting the pressed state to bg-primary/text-primary-foreground (matching ui:switch's on treatment) in the Toggle component only (toggleVariants untouched, so ui:toggle-group is unaffected), plus demos/JSDoc clarifying pressed-state appearance and Toggle-vs-Switch usage.
